[[Katharine]], of the [[Turtle Clan]], is a skilled crafter for the [[Luxon]]s, specializing in [[Incubator Kit]]s.

==Locations==
*[[The Jade Sea]]
**{{NPC location|Gyala Hatchery|explorable area}}

==Dialogue==
If you have already completed the scavenger hunt on that character or you do not have [[Zho's Journal]] in your inventory:
:''"Oh, hello. Is there something you need from me? I am a little busy, at the moment."''

If you have Zho's Journal, and have not yet completed the scavenger hunt on that character:
:''"I come from a long line of crafters in the Turtle Clan. We specialize in the carpentry of incubators for the hatchery. I'd be happy to make you a specially fitted incubator for your egg. Just bring me the materials and pay me for the labor. I'll even throw in some inlay work for free."''

==Notes==
*She first appeared after the [[Guild Wars Eye of the North Sneak Peek Weekend]] (24th-26th August 2007).
*She is located on the roof of the '[[leviathan (ship)|leviathan]]' - the big wooden structure off the side of the island. You can actually talk to her from beneath it. 
*Be sure to bring your [[Incubator_Kit#Acquisition|materials and money]] and [[Zho's Journal]] with you to buy the incubator.
